title.narrative: Supporting timely screening and diagnosis of HIV and AIDS, early ART initiation and good ART adherence for the 50+ population experiencing NCDS and intersectional

description.narrative: Overall Objective: of this project is to contribute to UNAIDS 90:90:90 targets through increased access to integrated age friendly Health, SRH and HIV care and treatment y addressing the triple threats of comorbidity among 50+ population living with HIV and experiencing gender and disability prejudices in Tanzania, Mozambique and Malawi. Specific Objective(s) of the action is: To ensure healthy ageing for 50+ individuals living with HIV and experiencing multiple vulnerability due to age, gender, and disability, through increased access to age friendly comprehensive health, Sexual Reproductive Health (SRH) and HIV care and treatments services;
